files.explanation: Adapted from the pinned pi-mimir file. The Pi Agent Skills standard becomes Pi skill authoring, defined once as Pi's skills documentation plus ../poteto-mode/playbooks/authoring-a-skill.md, with Pi's name and description limits in the frontmatter step. The recall tool becomes the per-cwd session directory rule in ../poteto-mode/playbooks/session-pickup.md, and slice miners are bare task:recon children per ../poteto-mode/references/fan-out.md reading only the session files the parent lists. The placeholder 'a user question' becomes asking in the reply and ending the turn. Placement writes the project's .pi/skills freely and ~/.pi/agent/skills only after explicit confirmation. Landing commits under the commit policy; push and PR each need explicit authorization per references/authorization.md. Cursor's AskQuestion, create-skill and ~/.cursor paths are not used.

Adapted from the pinned Cursor skill (no mimir copy). Bare slash commands became /skill: forms. Project-local skills write under .pi/skills/; a ~/.pi/agent/skills copy needs explicit confirmation. Installing a verification tool needs authorization (references/authorization.md). Generate step names the .pi/skills path. Hand-off points at /skill:maintain-formal-verification-skill. Cursor-only plugin resolution wording was not copied. Pin move to 1ba91fc25c0977741dd0e267849e6234b037ed0a: generated skills must read TLA+ results via /skill:statechart without copying its CLI.

One sentence says project .pi/skills writes need no permission and a ~/.pi/agent/skills copy needs explicit confirmation. Step 5 adds that pstack schedules nothing, so any maintenance cadence is the user's. Cursor's .cursor paths and bare /create-verification-skill commands are not used. Pin move to cursor/plugins f713f14: Launch readiness means usable from an empty data dir (migrations and seed), not merely that a process answers; a missing seed precondition fails the journey and is recorded in Gotchas; a stand-in proof lists unverified setup steps. Cursor .cursor paths and bare slash commands stay unused.

Adapted from the pinned pi-mimir file, not copied: the contract's copy candidate needed two Pi edits. Step 2's concurrent read-only subagents become bare Investigator children with task:recon launched per ../poteto-mode/references/fan-out.md. The changed outcome and step 6 keep the one-PR shape but say commits follow the commit policy and that pushing and opening the PR each need explicit authorization (references/authorization.md); without it the run stops at the local diff. Cursor's bare slash commands and .cursor paths are not used.

Re-authored for Pi under user decision D4 with the Cursor file as primary structure (the row has no pi-mimir source). The frontmatter name Make Bot UI becomes make-bot-ui and keeps disable-model-invocation true. The Cursor webhook routine, update_state, the secret-request card, the remote webhook URL and the chat-header shortcut panel are removed. The skill now guides a local page that POSTs to a server bound to 127.0.0.1, with Host, Origin, content-type, constant-time key, size and field validation, no CORS, one run at a time, and each accepted body written to a runs/ file and attached to a pi -p run through an argument array, with fixed instructions in --append-system-prompt and the body treated as untrusted data. The key is generated into a mode-600 local file and never printed or pasted in chat. A proof section probes loopback before calling it live. Kept from Cursor: one try with a timeout, probing with a harmless payload, never asking for Tailscale credentials, not creating a second hostname on an online node, and matching field names; installation, Tailscale exposure and any bind beyond loopback each need explicit authorization. Review fixes: the RPC alternative is removed, so every request is a fresh pi -p process with the same tool limits and a clean context. Host and any Origin are validated before every route including GET /; the served page holds no secret, the user enters the key in a memory-only password field, and the server reads the key file on each POST. The proof list adds a hostile-Host GET that returns 403 and checks that no response body contains the key.

Adapted from the pinned pi-mimir file. The nonexistent recall tool is replaced by $PI_SESSION_FILE and the per-cwd session directory rule in ../poteto-mode/playbooks/session-pickup.md, with the documented <timestamp>_<session-id>.jsonl layout and its session-dir overrides; chats are cited by session file, not UUID. The session-pickup route names its playbook path. Step 3's parallel cheap-model subagents become bare task:recon investigator children launched per ../poteto-mode/references/fan-out.md, each given explicit session file paths, with the leaf rule for a child that receives this skill. Step 4 marks the why skill planned W4 and adds the interim rule: one bare Investigator child per source with no tools key so MCP servers stay visible, reporting source control only and naming gaps when MCP is not visible, with one schema-valid example. Cursor's ~/.cursor transcript path is not used. W4 reconcile: the why planned W4 markers and the until-why-ships launch rule are retired; the sweep launches investigators as why does, without a tools key so MCP stays visible (gate G5), with the source-control-only report kept for operator-restricted tools.

Adapted from the pinned pi-mimir file. The transcript audit keeps $PI_SESSION_FILE and replaces the nonexistent recall tool with the per-cwd session directory rule in ../poteto-mode/playbooks/session-pickup.md, never another project's sessions. A start row's evidence names the run's session file instead of an agent id. Committing the log also requires the task's commit policy (references/authorization.md). The short principle name becomes principle-encode-lessons-in-structure. The cross-model trail review becomes a fan-out.md diversity seat: one schema-valid bare subagent example with the delegation.md Reviewer prompt, an exact <provider>/<model-id> from another family, tools read, bash and fork false, given the log path and the parent's session file path; with no other family it runs same-family and is labelled context-isolated in the Attention line; a child keeping a trail launches no reviewer and leaves the review to its parent.
